faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.item0_q: How do I get a price?
faq.item0_a: Send your journey with the form on this page, or call 07904 428896. We reply with a quote by email or phone, and nothing is booked until you accept it.
faq.item1_q: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.item1_a: Include your flight number. Flights are monitored, so your driver knows your actual arrival time and meets you in the arrivals hall.
faq.item2_a: As a guide, the E-Class and S-Class seat up to 4 with 3 cases, the V-Class up to 7, and the Tourneo Custom up to 8. Tell us what you’re bringing and we’ll recommend the right one.
faq.item3_q: Are your drivers and cars licensed?
faq.item3_a: Our drivers and vehicles are licensed by Epping Forest District Council, and our executive vehicles are exempt from displaying standard private hire plates.
faq.item4_a: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Apple Pay.
faq.item5_a: Our hours are Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 6.30pm. You can send a journey request with the form at any time and we’ll reply with a quote.
